Lib and I am going to retire early"* **Celestia Webster's Diary - November 13, 1867** ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "Map of Trips to Aunt Z just points" ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "library(tidyverse) library(sf) library(leaflet) library(paletteer) zlocations <- read_csv(z_locations) zlocations_sf <- st_as_sf(zlocations, coords = c(lng, lat), crs = 4326) pal <- colorFactor( palette = as.character(paletteer_d(colorBlindness::paletteMartin)), domain = zlocations_sf$location) leaflet() |> leaflet() |> addTiles() |> addCircleMarkers(data = zlocations_sf, fillOpacity = 0.5, radius = 3) |> addLegend(bottomleft, pal = pal, values = zlocations_sf$location)" ``` ::: ::: ## Map of Trips to Aunt Zerviah ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Map of Trips to Aunt Zerviah - One line for each individual ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "library(sf) library(tidygeocoder) library(USAboundaries) library(tidyverse) library(leaflet) library(paletteer) zlocations <- read.csv(z_locations.csv) zmovements <- read.csv(z_movements.csv) zlocations_sf <- st_as_sf(zlocations, coords = c(lng, lat), crs = 4326) zmovements_wide <- zmovements |> arrange(date) |> group_by(person) |> ungroup() |> filter(!is.na(start)) |> rowid_to_column(journeyid) zmovements_long <- zmovements_wide |> pivot_longer( cols = start:destination, names_to = type, values_to = location ) zmovements_long_sf <- zmovements_long |> left_join(zlocations, by = location) |> st_as_sf(coords = c(lng, lat), crs = 4326) |> group_by(journey_id) |> summarise(do_union = FALSE) |> st_cast(LINESTRING) journeys_sf <- left_join(zmovements_long_sf, zmovements_wide, by = journey_id) journeys_sf journeys_sf <- journeys_sf |> mutate(label = paste ( person,
, start, to, destination,
, year(date),day(date), month(date, label = TRUE))) pal <- colorFactor( palette = as.character(paletteer_d(colorBlindness::paletteMartin)), domain = journeys_sf$person) leaflet() |> addTiles() |> addPolylines(data = journeys_sf, color = ~pal(person), opacity = 0.8, label = ~person) |> addCircleMarkers(data = zlocations_sf, fillOpacity = 0.5, radius = 5, label = ~location) |> addLegend(bottomleft, pal = pal, values = journeys_sf$person)" ``` ::: :::
